description: You are given two lists of closed intervals firstList and secondList, each sorted by start time and pairwise disjoint. Return the intersection of these two interval lists.
intuition: Two sorted interval lists can be intersected with a two-pointer merge. The intersection of any two overlapping intervals is [max of starts, min of ends]. Advance whichever pointer has the earlier-ending interval.
approach: Use two pointers, one for each list. At each step, compute the intersection of the current intervals. If they overlap, add the intersection. Advance the pointer with the smaller end.
explanation:
1. Two pointers i, j start at the beginning of each list.
2. The intersection of current intervals is [max(starts), min(ends)].
3. If lo <= hi, the intervals overlap, add the intersection.
4. Advance the pointer whose interval ends first.
5. Continue until one list is exhausted.
hints: Two sorted interval lists can be merged with two pointers.
The intersection of two intervals is [max of starts, min of ends].
Advance the pointer with the earlier ending interval.
